data.gender_notes: Gudda is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gudda is a Hindu name that is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gudam' which means 'Goddess of Prosperity'. This name is believed to bring wealth, abundance, and prosperity in one's life. The name Gudda carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Gudda usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Gudda belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity.”
